text:
THIRTY-SIX YEARS LATE (bollawave)

[Intro]
Still valid.

[Verse 1]
I passed the exam in eighty-six,
they stamped it and I signed.
A classroom stood there waiting,
I left the thing behind.
A room of humming metal called,
the metal changed my mind.

[Pre-Chorus]
Everyone I ever taught
was already grown.
And the room I trained for
kept the light on, all alone.

[Chorus]
Thirty-six years late,
and I'm walking in on cue.
I never lost the time —
I was always coming through.

[Verse 2]
Then the ladder came and found me,
I took it two at a time.
Twenty-two whole academies,
and every one was mine.
Five hundred people clocking in,
and millions on the line.

[Pre-Chorus]
Everyone I ever taught
was already grown.
And the room I trained for
kept the light on, all alone.

[Chorus]
Thirty-six years late,
and I'm walking in on cue.
I never lost the time —
I was always coming through.

[Spoken Word]
Nineteen eighty-six: qualified. Higher teaching diploma. Sport and biology.
Nineteen eighty-seven: computing. Programming languages, eleven.
Then: instructor. Then: director.
Then: managing director, twenty-two institutes.
Then: the board. Then: sales. Then: consulting.
Then: more of the same, with a better chair.
And then he stopped.

[Bridge]
First day at seventy,
and the thirteen-year-olds don't care.
I trained for sport and biology —
there are computers everywhere.

[Chorus]
Thirty-six years late,
and I'm walking in on cue.
I never lost the time —
turns out the detour taught me too.

[Outro]
Thirty-six years late.
Right on time.

--- STYLE ---
funk soul, confident strut, 108 BPM, slap bass, tight horn section stabs, clavinet, live drum kit with rimshots, spoken-word interlude, warm seventies analog mix

--- EXCLUDE ---
big band swing, disco strings, gospel choir, schlager
